findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: introduce, get_network_info, list_resources · Private data: introduce, request_quote · Public sink: introduce, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: introduce, get_network_info, list_resources · Private data: introduce, request_quote · Public sink: introduce, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
